name: com.nova.modeling
description: A light Blender-style modeler inside the editor (Window > Model Editor): Object / Edit mode, vertex / edge / face selection, G R S with axis lock and typed values, Extrude, Inset, Loop Cut, Bevel, Subdivide, Subdivision Surface, Mirror, Symmetrize, Merge, Fill, Bridge, Shade Smooth, Undo. Opens FBX / OBJ / glTF (quads kept) and exports FBX, OBJ and GLB. Every operation is also a CLI command (nova model <op>) with JSON results and multi-view PNG renders, so an AI agent can model step by step and look at its work.
